build: npm run build:qa (cached production dist, QA hooks)

runs.label: v2-L5-fresh
runs.result: not finished (275 s, 1/5 found, driver stuck without a marker)

runs.label: v2-L6-fresh
runs.result: driver P0 cannot-finish at (-1.1,-28) after 100 s pinned by a riot cop

findings.what: Courier is very hard to find inside dense breach hordes at zoom 1.5: only her head and gun show between infected and a wall of 15-25 stacked red health bars; the new gold contour is not visible at this size. At zoom 0.5 the depth slice draws her cleanly on top of the horde.

findings.setup: fresh, WebGL2 low, zoom 0.5 (high identical at 12918)
findings.what: Infected corpses at close zoom read as faceted camo mosaics (red/yellow/black triangles), one with a black dithered wedge; living infected next to them read fine (PO checklist P1-117 'corpses look like bodies up close').

findings.where: Mia's hiding place and the search route
findings.what: Rescued survivors die within 5-15 s of the rescue; the only signal is the name card vanishing. Mia died 5-10 s after rescue in 3/3 runs (0.5 s strip t1646->t1960: about six infected reach her). In the strip Rosa met an Alpha-sized brute at her spot (60->35 HP by t5753, gone by t6198). Preset run reached the metro with 'Survivors in 0/1' and closed the shutter with nobody. Real-input driver with god mode does not guard the group (native bot rescues 5), so this is partly the driver, but there is no on-screen alarm.
A camera-side military truck wreck fills about 65% of the frame and the courier is pushed to the top edge, half on the truck; no see-through cut on the vehicle.

findings.setup: preset, WebGPU low, zoom 1.5 (also absent in the paused z0.5 photos at 4388 and 7992, both tiers)
findings.what: The corgi is not near the courier for about 3.5 min while the HUD says 'Corgi - following'; it is back at the metro. The fresh run kept it at heel. No position trace taken, so separation vs. render is not proven.

A riot-cop hatch member pins the courier on the glowing platform ledge for about 100 s; every shot shows 'BLOCKED - FLANK'; the driver ends with P0 cannot-finish while the HUD says 'Stay with the group - 247 m'. A human can probably flank, but the spot needs a human check.
The group shrinks to 'Let everyone pass - 0/1 through' and 'Bring the survivors into the night - 0/1 out' without a visible alarm (same pattern as vqa-1b #7; driver runs ahead).
The 'SHIELD STRAIN - CHIP' / 'SHIELD BROKEN' world label sits on top of the courier and corgi HUD cards.
Route distance jumps 312 -> 329 -> 80 m within 10 s (preset run showed 80 m at once).
Courier shown through a porthole cut in an apartment facade; she reads as standing on a balcony.

findings.setup: all 8 backend x tier x zoom cells
findings.what: Alley itself is clean (continuous paving, no void, no floating props, storefront end wall and roof intact). Two nits: a thin bright seam line across the paving where the alley meets the plaza (z about -22, zoom 0.5); at zoom 1.5 mid-alley the courier is only visible through a porthole in the Bakery/Harbor Books facade, so the passage is not readable from the game camera.
'BLOCKED - FLANK' label rides above the chasing horde for minutes; with 20+ red/teal bars it forms a ladder over the group.
Medkit pickup hovers at chest height, larger than the courier's torso.
Rosa walks with both arms raised right behind the courier, overlapping her.

checked_ok: L4 waves: west, north and south breaches each arrived with a large horde and Alpha callouts in both runs; plaza never empty; both runs finished.

L4 spearhead soldiers holding fire: 0.5 s strip over the contact phase (t2601-t4658, zoom 1, high WebGPU): plaza full of armed civilians and soldiers firing; no soldier seen idly watching a runner beside him. Not conspicuous.
L4 courier at zoom 0.5 in hordes (both survivors, both tiers): drawn on top, readable.
L5 tall-prop see-through: trees dither around the courier (t3703); readable.
L6 riot-cop hatch members read as armoured riot police (POLICE shields, red visors) at zoom 0.5 high.
L6 corgi and courier readable in the tunnel at both zooms.
not_covered: L5 follower start twitch and corgi parking beside the escort: 0.5 s strip run v2-L5-strip (preset, WebGPU high, zoom 1, 200 frames) lost Mia and Rosa 5-15 s after rescue, before any calm group start; not judged. Corgi stayed at heel in that strip.
L6 shelter recovery corpses after the retreat (camera never returned to the shelter).
L4 tank vs barrier, L4 alarm wave count (P1-116/118) not measured.
